UNLOADED.

No project instructions are present in my context. What I received was the harness system prompt, a memory-directory description, the git status snapshot, and your message. There is no CLAUDE.md content, no text about machine backlog paths, numbered phase gates, an Execution standard, or a shared instruction source.

Because of that I cannot answer the four questions or quote a sentence without fabricating, so I am declining to guess.

Likely cause: the probe script invokes Claude with `--setting-sources ''`. An empty setting-sources list disables loading of user, project, and local settings, which is where CLAUDE.md and other project instruction files are picked up. The `--tools ''` flag also prevents me from reading them on demand, which is consistent with your "no tools" instruction.

To make the smoke test meaningful, rerun with `--setting-sources project` (or `user,project,local`) and keep the rest of the flags as they are. If instructions still show as UNLOADED under that configuration, the problem is in the instruction files or their discovery path rather than the invocation.
